findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "proxy (unresolved DOM association)" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 0.15s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.
findings.snippet: tl.fromTo("proxy (unresolved DOM association)", { f: 48, duration: 3, ease: "none" }, 0.15) tl.fromTo("proxy (unresolved DOM association)", { f: 144, duration: 9.6, ease: "none" }, 15.84)

findings.message: <div id="scene1"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div id="seq1">. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="scene1"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
